latest_nl_proof:
Assume n > 1 is an integer and t is a real number such that floor(k t) = k - 1 for every integer k with 1 <= k <= n. We must show that E_n(t) = H_n - 1.

By the definition of E_n, we have
E_n(t) = floor(n t) - sum_{k=1}^n floor(k t)/k.

Since the hypothesis holds for every k in {1, ..., n}, it also holds for k = n, so floor(n t) = n - 1. Moreover, for each k = 1, ..., n,
floor(k t)/k = (k - 1)/k = 1 - 1/k.
Therefore
sum_{k=1}^n floor(k t)/k = sum_{k=1}^n (1 - 1/k) = n - sum_{k=1}^n 1/k.
Writing H_n for the nth harmonic number, H_n := sum_{k=1}^n 1/k, this becomes
sum_{k=1}^n floor(k t)/k = n - H_n.
Hence
E_n(t) = (n - 1) - (n - H_n) = H_n - 1.
This is exactly the desired conclusion.
